title_cyr: Чува мајка до две лути ќерки
title_latin: Čuva majka do dve luti ḱerki
title_en: A mother raised two fierce daughters
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional curse song. 'Чува мајка' is my reading as 'a mother raised'; 'Што ми биле' line is rendered literally as 'What were they'.

lines.cyr: Чува мајка до две лути ќерки,
lines.lat: Čuva majka do dve luti ḱerki,
lines.en: A mother raised two fierce daughters,

lines.cyr: т'нко преле, па се луто колнат:
lines.lat: t'nko prele, pa se luto kolnat:
lines.en: they spun thread thin and cursed each other bitterly:

lines.cyr: ти од срце рода да си немаш.
lines.lat: ti od srce roda da si nemaš.
lines.en: may you have no kin from your heart.

lines.cyr: ти од срце рода да си имаш.
lines.lat: ti od srce roda da si imaš.
lines.en: may you have kin from your heart.

lines.cyr: Да си имаш девет мили сина,
lines.lat: Da si imaš devet mili sina,
lines.en: May you have nine dear sons,

lines.cyr: да си имаш, да си ги ожениш.
lines.lat: da si imaš, da si gi oženiš.
lines.en: may you have them and marry them off.

lines.cyr: Ред да дојде војска да ги пратиш,
lines.lat: Red da dojde vojska da gi pratiš,
lines.en: When the time comes, send them to the army,
and let a gun suddenly go off.

lines.cyr: Да ти удри девет мили сина,
lines.lat: Da ti udri devet mili sina,
lines.en: May it strike your nine dear sons,

lines.cyr: да ти удри, да ти ги отепа.
lines.lat: da ti udri, da ti gi otepa.
lines.en: may it strike, may it kill them for you.
May it leave nine dear daughters-in-law,

lines.cyr: Што ми биле девет мили снаи,
lines.lat: Što mi bile devet mili snai,
lines.en: What were they, nine dear daughters-in-law,
